title: Addition
introduction: Explore addition through definitions, examples and practice.
definition: Addition combines quantities to find their total. The numbers added are called addends; the result is the sum.

formulas.description: a and b are addends; c is their sum.
Adding zero leaves a number unchanged.
Changing the order of the addends does not change the sum.

examples.question: Find 27 + 15. Add ones: 7 + 5 = 12. Regroup ten ones as one ten. Add tens: 2 + 1 + 1 = 4.

exercises.question: Sam has 16 pencils and gets 9 more. How many pencils?
